# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-02T18:00Z · next run ~23:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-03T08:00Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 26 measured from open data, 14 follow a published figure, 49 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 40/100 (Strained) · 18 Alert · 37 Watch · 34 Normal Headline: Iran offers to reopen Hormuz within two days if the US lifts its blockade, but Doha talks ended without a deal; Brent eased to near $105. Cyclone Murasu, a GDACS red alert, is due ashore in Andhra Pradesh overnight.
## Situations (9 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Doha talks ended 1 Nov without a deal; Iran offers to reopen Hormuz within two days if the US lifts its blockade (2 Nov). Brent near $105, TTF near €95. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, oil, eu-gas, fertiliser, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: Russia launched 759 drones on 1 Nov and 193 on 2 Nov, cutting power in 10 regions; the Kherson truce ended; drones closed Jersey airspace 30–31 Oct. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, hybrid-threats, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.2: drought in Australia and East Africa, record warmth and weaker carbon sinks. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: DR Congo reports more than 5,000 Ebola deaths and 10,300+ cases (2 Nov), with cases in Kenya and Nigeria; a WHO emergency (PHEIC) since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Record drone attacks on civilians in October; the army rejects talks; famine confirmed in 2025. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - Cyclone Murasu [ALERT, worsening]: GDACS red alert; IMD expects landfall near Ongole, Andhra Pradesh 23:30–04:00 local on 2–3 Nov, winds 100–110km/h; about 30,000 to be evacuated. → alert: other-cyclones; normal: floods - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread about 159bp (30 Oct); hundreds of thousands protested with clashes on 31 Oct, as unrest also hit Germany. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US CPI at 4.0% on the oil shock; a Bank of England rise is widely expected on 5 Nov; Egypt hiked on 29 Oct. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility; normal: em-stress - Record Binance hack attributed to North Korea [WATCH, stable]: About $6.3bn drained from Binance in late October; FBI blamed North Korea; Binance says 95% replaced and withdrawals restored in phases (2 Nov). → watch: crypto, cyber, korea
## Other Alerts - Global food prices [food-prices] worsening: FAO food price index 136.0 in September, above the 135 Alert line; October due 6 Nov - Sahel insurgency [sahel] stable, AI-judged: JNIM's blockade of Bamako continues; Mali relies on escorted fuel convoys - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
